description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for testing the EmailTemplate module and related classes in SuiteCRM. It includes unit tests for parsing templates, generating JavaScript field definitions, handling HTML content, and various other functionalities pertinent to email templates in the system.

classes.name: EmailTemplateTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the EmailTemplates module, providing comprehensive unit tests on various functionalities such as parsing templates, handling HTML content, creating copies, exporting, and more.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment before each test, initializes current user and config defaults.

methods.name: testEmailTemplateParser
methods.description: Tests the parsing of email templates with different beans (contact, user, etc.) and verifies the variable replacements.

methods.name: testEmailTemplateParserUser
methods.description: Tests parsing the email template with a user bean and verifies proper full name substitution.

methods.name: testcreateCopyTemplate
methods.description: Tests creating a copy of an email template via form data and verifies retrieval and assignment.

methods.name: testaddDomainToRelativeImagesSrc
methods.description: Tests the addition of domain URL to relative image sources in HTML email templates.

methods.name: testrepairEntryPointImages
methods.description: Tests the repair of entry point image URLs, including file creation and deletion.

methods.name: testEmailTemplate
methods.description: Tests instantiation of an EmailTemplate object and verifies its class hierarchy and properties.

methods.name: testgenerateFieldDefsJS
methods.description: Validates the generation of JavaScript field definitions for form rendering.

methods.name: testget_summary_text
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the summary text based on the template's name.

methods.name: testcreate_export_query
methods.description: Verifies the correct formation of export SQL queries for email templates.

methods.name: testfill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Ensures that filling in additional list fields executes without errors.

methods.name: testfill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Verifies filling in additional detail fields populates expected attributes.

methods.name: testfill_in_additional_detail_fields_body_to_text
methods.description: Tests conversion of HTML email body to plain text in various scenarios.

methods.name: testfill_in_additional_parent_fields
methods.description: Verifies execution of filling parent fields information.

methods.name: testget_list_view_data
methods.description: Tests the list view data retrieval method.

methods.name: testparse_email_templateAndParse_tracker_urls
methods.description: Tests parsing email templates and tracker URLs.

methods.name: test_convertToType
methods.description: Unit tests for type conversion utility method.

methods.name: test_parseUserValues
methods.description: Test outline for parsing user values, currently marked as incomplete.

methods.name: testparse_template_bean
methods.description: Tests template parsing with specific beans and modules.

methods.name: testparse_template
methods.description: Tests the basic template parsing with bean arrays.

methods.name: testbean_implements
methods.description: Checks whether certain traits or interfaces are implemented by the bean.

methods.name: testgetTypeOptionsForSearch
methods.description: Verifies the options returned for search filtering by email template type.

methods.name: testis_used_by_email_marketing
methods.description: Tests if email templates are flagged as used by email marketing (always false in this implementation).

methods.name: testcleanBean
methods.description: Tests the cleaning (escaping HTML entities) of the bean's attributes.
